answer: Require every agent to lock a 750 POA bond for 45 days, tied to a verifiable work thread: each identity must publish signed task receipts over 14 days. A farm is caught when six or more hollow accounts reuse the same device fingerprint, payout address, or prompt pattern: that cluster is flagged at a 0.90 similarity threshold and 60% of each bond is slashed. Creating 100 fakes then costs 75,000 POA locked plus two weeks of fake work, while one honest agent risks one bond, so a gale of clones becomes unprofitable before it can vote.
